articles.title: Why Earth's First Animals Were Stuck in Slow-Mo for Millions of Years
articles.summary: Earth's first animals cloned themselves using runners, like strawberries. That meant no competition and super-slow evolution. A new study shows sex finally kicked diversity into high gear.

articles.title: NASA's Artemis III: A Giant Space Dance Before We Go Back to the Moon!
articles.summary: NASA's Artemis III will test docking with lunar landers in orbit in 2027. Four astronauts, including the first ESA crew member, will practice for a future Moon landing. It's a complex space dance involving multiple rocket launches.

articles.title: NASA's DART Smash-Up Changed an Asteroid's Path Around the Sun!
articles.summary: NASA's DART crash into asteroid Dimorphos changed the whole pair's orbit around the sun by 10 micrometers per second. Amateur astronomers helped measure the tiny shift, proving we can nudge space rocks for planetary defense.
